firstPlayerRule: The youngest player takes the first turn. Play then continues clockwise.
houseFallback: If age does not settle it, your group can agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule, not a tie-break supplied by this rulebook.
clarifications: This entry covers the base game in the cited V3 rulebook, not expansions or other Carcassonne games.
internalEvidence: Publisher product page links this V3 PDF. Page 3 was rendered and visually checked; the starting instruction names the youngest player. Page 6 carries copyright 2000 and 2021.
uncertainty: No tie between equally young players is resolved in the cited starting instruction.
